scope: Remaining paper experiments: six historical GSM8K reevaluations and combined checkpoint reconstruction; full controlled DAG including token-matched arms, three seeds, length sensitivity, MATH-500 and sampled pass@8. No teacher generation or new hardware study.
limits: These are runtime extrapolations, not guaranteed upper bounds or approval to spend.
Only 32 primary evaluation questions and six GRPO steps were measured. Other arm workloads and future completion lengths can differ.
4K/8K, MATH-500 symbolic scoring and eight-sample throughput/memory have not been measured; pilot and re-price these before broad dispatch.
Every-response-at-limit scenario uses measured primary throughput. Reduced long-context throughput could cost more than that scenario.
SFT step counts for other arms use known or estimated packed sequence counts; require fresh token-cache preparation for an executable quote.
CPU/RAM charged using existing two-core/16-GiB allowance, fixed measured setup plus 120 seconds per GPU job; setup and retry contingency added separately.
Historical cost assumes available usable checkpoints; any required historical retraining is excluded. Six historical evaluations remain separate from the new instructed protocol.
Prices are before account credits and taxes. No newly paid jobs were started.
